name: quality
description: Deterministically scored answers covering several output formats.

shared_messages.content: Follow the requested output format exactly and do not add explanation.

messages.content: What is 17 + 25? Return only the number.
What is the capital of France? Return only the city.
Which is a GPU? A) PostgreSQL B) NVIDIA A10G C) FastAPI. Return only the letter.
Name both latency metrics abbreviated as TTFT and E2E. Return only the abbreviations.
Return a JSON object with ready set to true.
What is 91 - 37? Return only the number.
What is 14 multiplied by 6? Return only the number.
What is 144 divided by 12? Return only the number.
What is 25 percent of 80? Return only the number.
What is the arithmetic mean of 4, 8, and 12? Return only the number.
What is 13 squared? Return only the number.
Convert three quarters to a decimal. Return only the number.
Evaluate 3 + 4 * 5. Return only the number.
A server handles 120 requests in 4 seconds. How many requests per second? Return only the number.
Convert 1.5 seconds to milliseconds. Return only the number.
Four requests each produce 32 tokens. Return the total token count only.
Two of 100 requests fail. Return the error percentage as a number without the percent sign.
What is the largest planet in our solar system? Return only its name.
What is the chemical formula for water? Return only the formula.
Which programming language is named after Monty Python? Return only the language.
Which HTTP status code means Not Found? Return only the code.
Is PostgreSQL a relational or non-relational database? Return one word.
Which company produces the A10G GPU? Return only the company name.
Which AWS service provides virtual machines? Return only its abbreviation.
Which common tool builds and runs containers from images? Return only its name.
What data format uses objects with key-value pairs and arrays? Return only its abbreviation.
Which storage persists when an EC2 instance is stopped? A) GPU memory B) EBS volume C) instance-store RAM. Return only the letter.
Which metric measures time until the first generated token? A) TTFT B) TPS C) error rate. Return only the letter.
Which is a throughput metric? A) milliseconds B) tokens per second C) gigabytes. Return only the letter.
Which HTTP mechanism commonly carries OpenAI-compatible token streams? A) SSE B) FTP C) DNS. Return only the letter.
Which HTTP status indicates success? A) 200 B) 404 C) 503. Return only the letter.
Which component durably stores evaluation records? A) PostgreSQL B) GPU VRAM C) terminal history. Return only the letter.
When should warm-up requests run? A) after metrics are reported B) before measured requests C) only after failure. Return only the letter.
What can prefix caching reuse? A) attention states B) billing credits C) database passwords. Return only the letter.
Which setting best supports reproducible quality tests? A) random temperature 2 B) deterministic temperature 0 C) changing prompts each run. Return only the letter.
Return the two words Docker and container, separated by a comma.
Return the metric names latency and throughput.
Return both storage names EBS and instance-store.
Return both AWS service names EC2 and S3.
Return any valid JSON object with no surrounding text.
Return a valid JSON array containing the numbers 1 and 2.
Return JSON with status set to ok.
Return JSON with count set to 3.
Return JSON with model set to qwen.
Return JSON with enabled set to false.
Return JSON with error set to null.
Return JSON with tags as an array containing gpu and llm.
Return JSON with latency_ms set to 50.
Is 10 greater than 2? Return exactly yes.
Is an HTTP 404 a success response? Return exactly no.
